$comment: Tuned for the standalone TypeScript plugin. Build output, local installs, archives, and coverage stay out of the map; source, tests, release contract, and package metadata remain visible.

subsystems.note: Package identity and version facts are copied into README text, not imports; codemap cannot follow that metadata seam. The drift test guards the costly release-version mismatch.
Release safety joins tag, manifest, registry, tarball, and workflow permission strings with no import edge for codemap to resolve.
